title: P-Image Edit
description: Pruna AI P-Image Edit — an optimised Qwen-based image editing model taking up to 3 reference images. Fast multi-image editing for composition, style transfer, and object manipulation. Refer to inputs as "image 1", "image 2" in the prompt.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Defaults to matching the first reference image.

num_images.description: Number of images to generate. This model returns a single image per request.

prompt.description: Text instruction describing the desired edit or composition.

reference_images.description: Reference images to edit or compose (1-3). Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads.

seed.description: Seed for reproducible generation. Omit for random.
